scripts.build-webgl-win: robocopy "%cd%\apps\aarena" "%cd%\apps\aarena_clone_WebGL" /MIR /XD "Library" "Temp" "Obj" "Build" "Logs" "UserSettings" && sleep 2 && call "C:\Program Files\Unity\Hub\Editor\2022.3.32f1\Editor\Unity.exe" -batchmode -nographics -quit -projectPath "%cd%\apps\aarena_clone_WebGL" -executeMethod MultiPlatformBuildScript.Build -logFile - -buildPath "%cd%\Builds\WebGL" -buildTarget "WebGL" && call powershell -c "(New-Object Media.SoundPlayer '%cd%\apps\aarena\Assets\TPSBR\Audio\not_a_joke.mp3').PlaySync();" && call npx http-server "%cd%\Builds\WebGL"
